checks.message: Rebooting disconnects active users and any unsaved work is lost
checks.context: Active desktop sessions are terminated immediately. Users must reconnect after the reboot completes. Notify users before rebooting to avoid data loss.

checks.message: Termination permanently destroys the WorkSpace and all user data on it
checks.context: All data on the user volume (D: drive) is permanently deleted. The root volume is also destroyed. There is no undo. Create a snapshot or backup before terminating.
